description:
Outbound calls of the database: Telegram and webhooks from `api.outbox` or `POST /call/<name>`.

    Three parts: allowed hosts, secrets and call descriptions. Secret VALUES never go
    through this tool or the chat: the person sets them in the panel (Data API →
    Outbound) or with `npx layero@latest data secrets set NAME` reading stdin; here
    only names are listed. Allow the host before describing a call to it. Changes
    need the person's consent. Needs a token with the admin scope.

action.description: `list` — allowed hosts, secret names and call descriptions; `add_host` / `remove_host` — a host the gateway may call; `set_call` — create or replace a call description; `remove_call` — delete it; `log` — recent calls with status code and refusal reason.
action.title: Action

confirmed.description: true — the person has already agreed in the chat after seeing what will change. A client with forms does not need it: the server asks the person itself. Never set it without the person's explicit consent.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

database.description: The database: name, slug or id. Without it — the organization's only database with the Data API enabled.
database.title: Database

host.description: For add_host and remove_host: a domain name, `api.telegram.org`.
host.title: Host

organization.description: Organization slug. Without it — the only one, or the personal one.
organization.title: Organization

title: Data API базы: исходящие вызовы
